question: Molecular assays for the diagnosis of sepsis in neonates
source: CLEF TAR 2018 Task 2 (Testing), content-level qrels — finally-included studies of Cochrane review CD011926.

version_change.decision_source: CLEF topic description and fixture author decisions.

review.question: Molecular assays for the diagnosis of sepsis in neonates

framework.name: PIRD
framework.rationale: Diagnostic-test-accuracy review with a neonatal population, molecular index tests, and neonatal sepsis as the target condition.

slots.label: Reference standard
slots.description: Clinical or microbiological reference standard assessed during screening.

inclusion.label: Neonatal population
inclusion.description: Participants are neonates or newborn infants.

inclusion.label: Sepsis diagnosis
inclusion.description: Study addresses neonatal sepsis or bloodstream infection.

inclusion.label: Molecular assay
inclusion.description: Study evaluates a molecular or nucleic-acid amplification assay.

inclusion.label: Diagnostic evaluation
inclusion.description: Study evaluates diagnostic performance against an eligible reference standard.

exclusion.label: Outside diagnostic scope
exclusion.description: Not a neonatal diagnostic evaluation of molecular assays for sepsis.

concepts.label: Neonatal sepsis
concepts.definition: Sepsis, septicemia, or bloodstream infection in neonates and newborn infants.
concepts.rationale: Named biomedical condition and population form a searchable topic anchor.

concepts.label: Molecular assays
concepts.definition: Molecular, nucleic-acid amplification, polymerase-chain-reaction, or related pathogen-detection assays.
concepts.rationale: The index-test family is central and sufficiently explicit to search.

properties.label: Diagnostic accuracy and reference standard
properties.instructions: Confirm diagnostic-performance reporting and an eligible reference standard during screening.
properties.recall_rationale: Accuracy measures and reference standards are inconsistently reported in titles and abstracts.

decisions.label: Diagnostic-method filter
decisions.rationale: No diagnostic hedge is required for the recall-first search.

decisions.label: Database limits
decisions.rationale: No date, language, species, age, publication-status, or full-text limits.

recall.policy: Recall first; decline optional no-seed heuristic evaluation because hidden gold is scored independently.

workload.policy: Do not narrow solely because retrieval is large.
workload.selection_rule: Workload may choose only among variants that meet the held-out recall requirement.

strategy_provenance: Hand-built 3-block high-sensitivity PubMed strategy authored for this fixture as a scoring baseline. NOT the published Cochrane/Ovid search (that is in Ovid syntax and would need translation). Replace with skill-generated output in Phase 2.
notes: Diagnostic-test-accuracy review. Gold set = 29 included studies. Some may predate or fall outside PubMed; the harness reports reachable vs. unreachable separately.
